specification.population: all original training rows only; examined development evidence

recipe.inner_members: seed0 stop-fold0 and seed1 stop-fold1 of five fitting-cluster stopping folds
recipe.final_members: five stopping folds x six seeds0-5 =30

specification.objective: MSE(log1p half-life)+lambda within-allele RankNet; natural batches; target ties omitted; equal mass per contributing allele per batch; L2 weights only
specification.positive_selection: existing mean of three inner-fold median per-allele Spearman, min20; first within best fold-SE; small lambda then strong L2
specification.deployment_selection: one fold-SE on the independently selected procedures' inner scores, MSE first; no extra fits

validation.recipe: one real lambda0 canonical full200-epoch recipe member per representation: outer0 / inner0 / L2.01 / stop0 / seed0; saved raw member comparison; exact synthetic equivalence first

specification.reporting: pooled median per-allele Spearman min20 and min50; 2000 shared paired whole-cluster bootstrap draws; saved selection table; MSE and MAE on anchored log1p scale; no affine mapping
specification.uncertainty: conditional on fitted predictions and inner selection; no independent confirmation; fixed two-member screening differs from final30 members
limits: MSE anchors scale; no pure ranking claim
R0/R5 widths and parameter counts differ
no transfer extension, expanded lambda, stopping change, repeats, or automatic scope expansion

prior_runtime_compatibility.package_versions: not recorded by historical embedding screen; exact sources/features and real lambda0 member comparison provide bounded compatibility evidence

specification.artifact_distribution: commit/distribute all finalized member NPZ, receipts and CSV/JSON; NPZ are normally ignored, so explicitly allowlist finalized reports/finalization/ranking/** NPZ; never include partial arrays or launch-only fits

execution.single_owner: exclusive durable controller receipt; interrupted unreceipted members require explicit recovery review
